title: South Korea Will Nearly Double Government AI Spending to 21.3 Trillion Won
summary:
President Lee announced that the South Korean government will expand its financial commitment to the artificial intelligence sector starting next year. Total expenditures for AI investment will reach 21.3 trillion won, representing a nearly 100% increase over the current budget.

The spending surge is part of a broader initiative to fund AI and other new growth drivers. Lee said the investments are intended to strengthen the nation's economic growth potential.
